title: Correlation immunity of a parity-based function
statement: For a positive integer $m$, define a function on $\\{\!-1,1\!\}^{3m}$ by taking the AND of the parities on the first $2m$ coordinates and on the last $2m$ coordinates. Every nonempty coordinate set of size at most $2m-1$ has Fourier coefficient zero for this function; hence it is correlation immune of order $2m-1$.
